name: @etzhayyim/repository-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of repository (Repository-in-Graph git object model: blob/tree/commit/ref over Actor DID) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Object store on AT PDS records (replaces RW/Hyperdrive); first-party source code = the user's own repo. FaaS build dispatch + build execution stay etzhayyim (consent-capability). Per ADR-0039 + ADR-2606011400 + ADR-2605172400.
